name: OSM Context Epoch Serving Flow
description: The OSM context epoch, named (mount /api/v1/osm/, config-mounted on the sdn-server lane; plan "OpenStreetMap on SDN" phase 3, owner decision 2026-09-03: hosted as FlatGeobuf). A $HTQ HttpRequest enters on the http-request trigger; osm-source:route answers with exactly one $HTR. "tileset.json" => the epoch record the off-fleet builder wrote (tools/osm-context/build-fgb.mjs), with PAYLOAD.CID from config key osm_epoch_cid and EPOCH_BASE_PATH relative to this node's origin (<osm_gateway_path><cid>/), public max-age=60, strong ETag, 304 on If-None-Match, CORS *. "" or "catalogue.json" => the camelCase discovery document. Without osm_epoch_record + osm_epoch_cid the record route answers 503 naming the keys. Anything else 404 no-store; non-GET/HEAD 405. The FlatGeobuf bytes are served by the node's IPFS gateway under the named CID, never by this flow; clients range-read them. Bridge linkage: the only host crossing is plugin.getConfig.

triggers.description: One $HTQ HttpRequest envelope per invocation, pumped by the host at the flow ingress.

api.tagDescription: The OpenStreetMap context epoch this node serves for the imagery detector (wasm; routing, conditional requests and response shaping run inside the module). Anonymous by design: every response is a cacheable pointer to content-addressed, ODbL-licensed data; nothing is written.

routes.summary: Which OSM context epoch this node serves
routes.description: The discovery document: epochId, delivery (ipfs | none), cid, datasetEpoch, epochBasePath (relative to this origin: <gateway path>/<cid>/), recordPath, format osm-context-fgb/1, attribution. cache-control public max-age=60 with a strong ETag.

application/json.description: epochId, delivery, cid, datasetEpoch, epochBasePath, recordPath, format, attribution.

routes.summary: The current OSM context epoch record
routes.description: The record tools/osm-context/build-fgb.mjs wrote for the pinned epoch (FORMAT osm-context-fgb/1): FILES with name, category, kind, bytes, sha256 and feature counts per FlatGeobuf file, DATASET_EPOCH, PROVENANCE (ODbL, attribution), PAYLOAD.CID naming the directory and EPOCH_BASE_PATH relative to this origin. THIS is the path clients read (OrbPro runtime/fgbContext.js loadFgbEpoch): they join EPOCH_BASE_PATH against the origin they already know and range-read the files. 503 with missingConfigKeys when no epoch is pinned.

application/json.description: osm-context-fgb/1 record with PAYLOAD.CID and EPOCH_BASE_PATH set.

503.description: No epoch configured; missingConfigKeys names the flow config keys.
